title: Bounded video finalisation pipeline
details: Adds a hard Android completion bound around the LO stop notification so Video Observation cannot wait forever for a missing stop event
Keeps the 2.63 track-ending strategy and one-second Android recording chunks
Replaces the video evidence media write with a bounded IndexedDB path that proceeds after the put request succeeds even if Android delays transaction completion
Retries private media storage once with a fresh database connection instead of hanging indefinitely
Keeps existing learner data, observations, reviews, QR, evidence and document formats unchanged
